text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит's been struggling lately,
so we go
to pray at a shrine... where for
some reason we're
joined by Biwa
Hayahide.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, you know, these places have all
sorts of
rules, and I'm not great with
smartsy stuff like
that...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But Hayahide's super smart, so I figured
if we
bring her along, I can just do
everything exactly
as she says!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Besides, she was the one who suggested
I go pray
at the shrine in the first place!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I doubt praying would
have any
effect. However, it's a fact that
issues with
physical performance are
closely linked to
psychological factors.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Given Ticket's naive mindset, it's quite
possible
that such methods will be...
well, I'm sure you get
my drift.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Good. Let's try it out then. Ticket, just
do as I
taught you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ALL RIIIGHT! First, I throw the coin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит hurls the coin with all her
might.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wh-wha?! Strength is not a necessity
here, Ticket!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Next, I ring the big bell!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: CLATTER! CLANG! CLATTER!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: C-come now, Ticket! That's far too loud!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! I gotta give it a good
ring, or the
gods in the sky won't hear
me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And lastly! My prayer to the god of the
shrine!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: CLAP, CLAP, CLAP, CLAP!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: RAAAGH! Please listen to MEEE!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Hrrngh! You there, god? Please, please, please let me get out of my slump!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ticket... Hey, Ticket!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
How long are you going to stand there?
That's
enough praying.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it is? Did every last bit of my
wish make
it up there?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's sufficient. I'm sure the god is
sick of—I
mean, satisfied with your
prayer.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's good. Then I'm sure I'll be
doing
better in no time!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you know what?! I already feel like
a weight
lifted off me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: That's not possible. It's far too soon—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm better! I'm sure of it! HOORAY! The god here is amazing!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it! I'm full of energy and
poweeer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It appears that she really has recovered.
There's
some truth to mind over matter
after all, I
suppose...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hngh... Hnnngh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Go, wishes, GO! Make it all the way to
the god of
the shrine!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sigh... She's not listening to me at all.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... I'm feeling kinda hot... And like, all dizzy...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Are you developing a fever from
concentrating
too hard? How is that
even possible?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sway... sway...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Because she focused so much energy on
praying,
Уиннинг Тикит ultimately fails
to get out of her
slump.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whether the result of prayer or because
of her
earnest personality, Winning
Ticket manages to
break out of her
slump.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
